test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b2ac943dd4c7295bd0f2d455599481e7199005c0e52d75bcd21ac29e91563fa.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e8fbc1e6694b551f94aa339174f62cb015ac87fcfba80d7c2675bc8f858706f.png] 

(3 + 5 + 2 + 4) = (2 × 7) 

14 = 14 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24992f5e686ba3f7afd4f661df04230eb9d2998a029ef52a64042baa9793a11c.png] 

(7 + 2 + 1 + 5) = (3 × 5)

15 = 15 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a99bb2a1c89b864de677efedf06bf915a523db7bd967987c35c1d9a9e40d4ed5.png] 

(6 + 4 + 1 + 1) = (? × 3)

12 ÷ 3 = ?

4 = ?

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
